This page lists the authoritative documents that anchor every Unit
on this site. Per-Unit "Further reading / listening" callouts point
to specific authentic resources for that topic; the references below
are the framework, not the topic-by-topic reading.

## Curriculum

- **curriculum framework (Bildungsplan) 2016 — Sekundarstufe I — Englisch (Erste
  Fremdsprache).** Ministerium für Kultus, Jugend und Sport Baden-
  Württemberg. <https://www.bildungsplaene-bw.de/>
- **curriculum framework (Bildungsplan) 2021 — Gymnasiale Oberstufe — Englisch (Basisfach
  und advanced course (Leistungsfach)).** Ministerium für Kultus, Jugend und Sport
  Baden-Württemberg. <https://www.bildungsplaene-bw.de/>
- **Gemeinsamer Europäischer Referenzrahmen für Sprachen (GER) /
  CEFR Companion Volume.** Council of Europe.
  <https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages>

## Pedagogy and didactics

- Penny Ur. *A Course in English Language Teaching.* Cambridge UP.
- Jim Scrivener. *Learning Teaching.* Macmillan.
- Scott Thornbury. *About Language*; *How to Teach Speaking*;
  *How to Teach Vocabulary*. Pearson.
- Paul Nation. *Learning Vocabulary in Another Language.* Cambridge UP.
- David Crystal. *The Cambridge Encyclopedia of the English Language.*
  Cambridge UP.

## Language reference

- *Cambridge Grammar of English* — Carter & McCarthy.
- *Practical English Usage* — Michael Swan, Oxford UP.
- *Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English* (online).
